title.en: AI / Machine Learning Engineer | Industrial AI & Optimization

summary.zh: 北科大自動化科技碩士，具機械工程背景。現任廣達電腦 AI 數據工程師，評估設備時序資料與 Machine Learning 應用可行性；具資料中心冷卻最佳化研究、Python 營運自動化、AOI 模型評估及車用 LED 研發驗證經驗。
summary.en: AI Data Engineer at Quanta with an M.S. in Automation Technology and a mechanical engineering background. Experienced in equipment time-series assessment, ML feasibility, data-center cooling research, Python automation, AOI evaluation and automotive LED R&D.

company.zh: 廣達電腦股份有限公司

bullets.zh: 與 SCADA、自動化及設備團隊協作，定義設備資料欄位、時間戳記、取樣頻率與資料品質需求
bullets.en: Work with SCADA, automation and equipment teams on data fields, timestamps, sampling frequency and quality requirements

bullets.zh: 盤點設備時序與製造資料，進行探索與品質檢查，評估異常偵測、設備健康度、預測維護與能源管理的 Machine Learning 可行性
bullets.en: Explore equipment time series and manufacturing data; assess ML feasibility for anomaly detection, equipment health, predictive maintenance and energy management

bullets.zh: 規劃模型驗證方式及與智慧工廠平台、Dashboard、告警系統整合的後續方向
bullets.en: Plan model validation and potential integration with smart-factory platforms, dashboards and alerting systems

bullets.zh: 以 Python 建構倉儲、庫存、補貨及商品主資料的內部自動化與資料處理工具
bullets.en: Developed Python tools for warehouse operations, inventory, replenishment and product master data

bullets.zh: 整合跨平台資料與規則型決策邏輯，開發文字分類及客服輔助等 AI workflow
bullets.en: Integrated cross-platform data and rule-based decision support; developed text classification and customer-service AI workflows

bullets.zh: 以功能規格、日誌、回歸測試與 CI/CD 流程改善系統的可驗證性及維護性
bullets.en: Improved testability and maintainability through specifications, logging, regression tests and CI/CD

title.zh: 研發工程師（研發替代役）

company.zh: 億光電子工業股份有限公司

bullets.zh: 參與高功率車用 LED 新產品開發，導入 Top Contact 散熱設計及新型晶片，協助體積縮小 15%、亮度提升 10%
bullets.en: Supported automotive LED NPI using top-contact thermal design and a new die architecture, contributing to 15% smaller volume and 10% higher brightness

bullets.zh: 依 APQP、AEC-Q 進行工程與可靠度驗證，協作分析光、電、熱及製程問題
bullets.en: Conducted APQP/AEC-Q engineering and reliability validation, investigating optical, electrical, thermal and process issues

name.zh: 資料中心冷卻 AI 代理模型與最佳化
name.en: AI Surrogate Model for Data Center Cooling

bullets.zh: 以 DE-MRBFNN 建立冷卻參數代理模型，結合 NSGA-III 尋找多目標較佳解。
bullets.en: Developed a DE-MRBFNN cooling surrogate and used NSGA-III for multi-objective optimization.

bullets.zh: 使用 CFD 模擬與實際場域測試，分別驗證模型與冷卻效益。
bullets.en: Evaluated the cooling configurations through CFD simulation and field testing.

name.zh: IC 載板 AOI 瑕疵辨識與模型評估

bullets.zh: 參與影像標註、特徵分析、模型訓練與評估，理解漏判率與誤判成本
bullets.en: Participated in image labeling, feature analysis, training and evaluation, with attention to missed defects and false alarms

name.zh: Python 營運自動化與決策支援

bullets.zh: 針對倉儲、庫存與補貨作業設計資料流程、規則判斷、測試與系統維護機制
bullets.en: Designed data workflows, rule-based logic, tests and maintenance practices for warehouse, inventory and replenishment processes

degree.zh: 自動化科技研究所 碩士
